name: @tradrl/rl-protocol
description: RL interface/trainer bridge contracts: the LEARNING-LOOP method taxonomy, explicit versioned RewardModels attached post-hoc to recorded trajectories (L7 — rewards are data, never the sole criterion), the deterministic five-operation EpisodeDriver over environment-protocol step mirrors (L4/L8), the TrainingRunProtocol with the full L9 lineage block (ReplayRunRecord mirror), the append-only trial emission into the experiments TrialRecord mirror (L11), and the injected Environment/Policy ports (Work Order T013).
